svg.text: Cut 430 x 330 from 6 mm clear cast acrylic; flame or sand

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the edges smooth and leave the film on until fitted.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four latch keepers on the front face: centred 95 above and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 95 below the door's centre line, 1 mm in from each side edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Mark the keeper holes through the keeper; drill 3 mm,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: M3 screws with nuts, a nylon washer under each.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the door's back face presses on the gasket on the front

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: frame; it overlaps the 400 x 300 opening by 15 all round.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four draw latches on the frame tabs pull it on.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: with the latches closed the gasket is squeezed evenly;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: a strip of paper is held tight all round.
